scope: Proposition 4.7 (Compatible direct images on normalized charts) of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let U → B be an integral separated étale algebraic neighborhood, let π : C → U be an integral finite normal Galois quasi-étale chart, and let h : Z → C be the normalized source chart of Proposition 3.3. For the global degreewise isomorphisms ϕj : Rjf∗OX → Ω [j] B fixed after Proposition 2.1, there are unique isomorphisms ϕj,C : Rj h∗OZ ∼ − − → Ω [j] C , 0 ≤ j ≤ n, whose restrictions to C◦ = C ×B Breg are the ordinary flat pullbacks of ϕj. The degree-zero map is the unit. These isomorphisms are compatible with ordinary étale refinement and with every normalized main overlap whose projections are étale. In particular they give compatible ambient identifications Nj,α = Rjhα∗OXα on the charts of Proposition 4.5.
